$intent: Curated Pexels briefs for the scenes where B-roll earns its place. Type-led scenes have no footage entry. Selection rules and grading are in scripts/prepare-footage.ts and src/components/SceneShell.tsx.
$audienceNotes: Imagery is sober, contemplative, and free of any content that would jar an Arab institutional audience.
No people-focused footage; no party / nightlife / urban / advertising aesthetics.
Forest, canopy, light, water, and architectural-scale nature only.
Slow aerials and macro nature reads as scientific gravitas, which the film earns.

scenes.intent: Slow aerial pullback over a tropical canopy at first light. Establishes the film's contemplative register before the narrator says 'Voluntary carbon has a structural problem.' Avoid anything urban or human-centric.
Vast canopy aerial that visualises the scale of what the metrics describe (700K+ ha, 30M+, 100M+). Wide horizon, no close subjects.
Ground-level forest interior with light rays through the canopy. Carries the Maqasid framing — stewardship, life, lineage. Reverent, never cliché.
Equatorial aerial that grounds the Shabunda + Gabon portfolio. Avoid anything resembling agriculture or settlements; pure forest + watercourse only.
Quiet forest dawn — closes the film with a return to the natural object the platform is built around. Holds the longest of any scene.
